1 player(s): a reroll (odd seed) or buys in the first shop, then play on to the second shop.
2 player(s): a reroll (odd seed) or buys in the first shop, then play on to the second shop.
3 player(s): a reroll (odd seed) or buys in the first shop, then play on to the second shop.
1 player(s): a reroll (odd seed) or buys in the first shop, then play on to the second shop.
1 player(s): Market day at the round 2 event, then two re-rolls in the next shop (the first free, the second paid), six offers throughout.
2 player(s): Market day at the round 2 event, then two re-rolls in the next shop (the first free, the second paid), six offers throughout.
1 player(s): Drill at the round 2 event, the player raises collector b1 by one tier for free, then the shop.
2 player(s): Drill at the round 2 event, each player raises one of their own collectors (b1 and b8) by one tier for free, then the shop.

1 player(s): Blueprint at the round 3 event, each player takes the first building offered, then one re-roll and a purchase of the held slot (slot 5) by player 1; the held offer sits after the five rolled offers throughout.

2 player(s): Blueprint at the round 3 event, each player takes the first building offered, then one re-roll and a purchase of the held slot (slot 5) by player 1; the held offer sits after the five rolled offers throughout.
1 player(s): Caravan at the round 2 event (a Node and a building on offer): the player takes the Node and names the cell, then the shop.
2 player(s): Caravan at the round 2 event (gold, a building, an Upgrade): the players pick in turn, the Upgrade names building b8 on its taker's turn, one reward is left over; then the shop.

1 player(s): picks the Flowmancer, changes the pick to the Alchemist before Ready, readies (the step ends and Core placement opens), places the Core and readies: the run reaches the first build step. The picks are inputs: no stream moves, so the generator state after the pick step equals the one of a run that picked at once (compare run-replay.s1-p1-first-shop's `rng` at the same step).

2 player(s): Ann picks the Wardsmith and readies, Bo picks the Wardsmith too (duplicates are allowed) but has not readied; Ann un-readies (allowed while Bo is not ready), changes her pick to the Beastbinder, then both ready; Core placement and the first build step follow.
Ready before any pick is refused with specialist_not_picked (there is no skip): the replay stops at the first action.
A solo player picks and readies, which ends the pick step; a later pick is refused with wrong_step (the pick is fixed for the run: there is no respec).
2 player(s): Ann readies with her pick, then tries to change it while Bo has not readied: refused with locked_ready (Ready locks the pick, CP-17a).
A pick of an ID that is not in the roster is refused with unknown_specialist.
